```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
root <- if (file.exists("_config.yml")) getwd() else if (file.exists("../_config.yml")) normalizePath("..") else getwd()
hyp <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(root, "results/07_mechanism_hypotheses.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sumtxt <- tryCatch(readLines(file.path(root, "results/PIPELINE_SUMMARY.txt")), error = function(e) "Summary not yet written.")
```

# Chemistry reminder

PS backbone, 2'-MOE, all cytosines 5m-dC; architecture **unknown**; RNase-H compatibility **unknown**. Phenotype: increased SHANK3 expression for both ASOs.

# Top mechanism hypotheses
